title: Demo: RmlUi + QuickJS-ng dynamic game HUD (variant A viability check)
description: Build a windowed demo on this machine: RmlUi (master, already cloned in session scratchpad) + quickjs-ng minimal bindings; game-style HUD with animated health/mana bars, flying damage numbers, killfeed, minimap blips, buff icons with cooldown sweeps, glow/box-shadow/filter effects; JS drives a fake combat simulation at 60Hz. Goal: let user judge look-and-feel and dev ergonomics of variant A. Not UE integration yet.
close_reason: Shipped: RmlUi+QuickJS-ng windowed HUD demo, all 9 features, 657 LOC bindings, 0.07-0.12ms update / ~1ms render @1600x900, 144fps vsync. Sources archived in docs/research/hud-demo.

title: Spike: RmlUi RHI render backend + dedicated UI thread in UE 5.8.1
description: Validate variant A core loop: RmlUi Context + (later QuickJS) owned by a dedicated UI thread; double-buffered render-command handoff; replay via ICustomSlateElement (RDG, 5.5+ API) into Slate; measure windowed GPU cost at 1080p/4K (box-shadow/filters fill + VRAM). Blueprint: Noesis UnrealPlugin FNoesisRenderDevice. Guard premultiplied-alpha blend state and display-gamma vs HDR paths.

title: Spike (variant B validation): Linux opaque-FD GL<->Vulkan shared texture into UE 5.8.1
description: 1-day spike, all prerequisites verified on this machine (RTX 3090 Ti, NVIDIA 610.43.03): allocate exportable VkImage (OPAQUE_FD) on UE VkDevice via IVulkanDynamicRHI, wrap with RHICreateTexture2DFromResource, import into a surfaceless GL context via GL_EXT_memory_object_fd + glTexStorageMem2DEXT, render gradient, sync via exported semaphore, sample in a Slate widget. Success: correct pixels, no validation errors, no game-thread wait. Protocol details in docs/research/2026-07-29-webui-middleware.md and agent report (cef-3).

title: Design spec: VaCuus architecture + v1 scope (blocked on user decision)
description: After user picks variant (A recommended) and v1 JS scope (T1+T2 TSX/preact vs binding-only MVP): write design doc per brainstorming flow (docs/superpowers/specs/), covering engine-agnostic plugin API (view/input/binding/render handoff), threading model (UI thread + command handoff, no end-of-tick fence), component set (HUD/UMG/in-world), input/IME/gamepad routing, gamma/alpha composition, Fab packaging constraints (source-visible UE modules, no .exe).
notes: ROOT CAUSE of user-observed Servo breakage on busto.games/kiwipoker.io (both same codebase): (1) CSS zoom property ignored by Servo 0.3.0 — sites scale design canvas via style.zoom; (2) hover/pointer media features report touch-phone -> mobile layout on desktop. Viewport units/clamp OK. Chrome-vs-Servo screenshot pairs in scratchpad + docs/research addendum 2. Upstream fix status research in flight.

title: Market & middleware research: HTML render engines + architecture options
description: Deep research pass: Coherent Gameface architecture & UE integration nuances; candidate HTML render engines (CEF, Ultralight, RmlUi, Servo/Blitz, WPE, Sciter, litehtml, etc.); UE 5.x integration mechanics (shared GPU textures, render thread hooks, Slate/input); market/competition on Fab. Deliverable: comparison + 2-3 architecture variants with recommendation.
close_reason: Research delivered: 12-agent sweep + local benchmarks. Full report in docs/research/2026-07-29-webui-middleware.md. Recommendation: RmlUi+QuickJS-ng core, direct-RHI backend, dedicated UI thread; Servo as optional browser-grade tier; CEF disqualified.

title: VaCuus: ultra-optimized multithreaded web UI plugin for UE (Win/Linux/Mac)
description: Gameface-class HTML/web UI middleware as a UE plugin for PC platforms. Top priority: UI rendering/layout must never stall UE game or render threads — off-thread layout+paint, GPU texture sharing, minimal copies. Closest commercial analog: Coherent Gameface.
